title: Your First Memory Might Never Have Happened
question: How can I remember something that never happened?
promise: You will know why so many people's earliest memories are built later from photos and family stories, and how to test your own.
answer: A first memory from age two or younger is most likely a real feeling stitched to photos and family stories you met later, and it feels completely real.

thumbnail.subject: A baby in an old pram under a yellow blanket, close and soft-lit

firstTenSeconds: The mascot closes his eyes and a fuzzy memory bubble opens above him: himself as a baby in a pram. Narrator: "Think of your very first memory. Got it? There's a good chance it never happened."
whyClick: Everyone has a first memory, and nobody has ever checked whether theirs is real.
